commitDispositions.notes: Port protocol-relative remote host normalization and its upstream regression coverage.
Port the safe dead-code removal after confirming the predicates have no Not Codex consumers.
Port scoped package-reference preservation and adapt the regressions to the Not Codex composer.
Port legacy UUID worktree compatibility while retaining the Not Codex temporary branch prefix.
Port Claude Opus 5 model support across contracts, provider registration, and tests.
Port cloud-environment connection presentation fixes while preserving Not Codex onboarding behavior.
Port native mobile diff-highlighter grammar isolation and its regression coverage.
Port macOS fullscreen titlebar spacing across desktop IPC and the shared web layout.
Port duplicate workspace-root prevention, adapting overlapping sidebar and orchestration paths to retain Not Codex integrations.
Port over-indented Markdown list normalization and adapt it to the current Not Codex chat renderer.
Port remote localhost preview URL resolution for direct private-network environments and preview automation.
Port native mobile composer image serialization so client-only draft metadata is excluded from start-turn wire payloads.
Port iOS terminal Enter encoding so software-keyboard and fallback input paths send carriage return instead of Ctrl+J.
Port native mobile share-target ingestion, durable inbox handling, and new-task draft integration while preserving Not Codex branding and configuration.
Port the real-route mobile app-store screenshot harness, adapting native module paths, fixture branding, development identifiers, and capture endpoints for Not Codex.

Port Claude instance isolation through CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR so macOS Keychain credentials remain discoverable, while translating legacy Not Codex HOME roots to their nested .claude directories for compatibility.
Port scope-bound buffering before initial thread snapshot reads so live events published during snapshot loading are delivered instead of dropped.
Port bounded nightly desktop update release-note normalization and the sidebar changelog tooltip across the updater, shared contracts, state machine, and web UI.
Port literal Git pathspec handling for selected-file staging so metacharacters in filenames cannot stage unintended paths.
Port locale-stable diagnostics for parsed Git commands while preserving the caller locale for general subprocesses.

Reject the upstream T3-branded icon refresh and its tightly coupled export pipeline. Not Codex maintains independent protected brand assets and mobile identity, and the exporter depends on the replacement T3 Icon Composer source projects rather than providing a separable generic fix.
Reject the hardcoded T3 Code GitHub star-count update. Not Codex has an independent repository and intentionally omits the upstream vanity-stat block rather than publishing T3-specific metrics.
Port the explicit neutral fill for the existing byte-identical Cursor provider SVG so its light icon color does not depend on inherited styling.
Port Cursor's cursor-agent default executable and make provider maintenance honor a configured binary path so the unrelated Grok cursor command cannot be selected accidentally.
Port the corrected Vite+ task-runner documentation while preserving Not Codex command names, home-directory isolation, packaging identity, and development ports.
Port percentage-only preview panel width clamping so ultra-wide displays are no longer limited by a 1400px ceiling, together with the upstream regression coverage.
Port the pointer-dismissal guard for fallback context-menu leaf clicks so the opening right-click gesture cannot immediately select an item.
Port duplicate-rule removal when replacing a custom keybinding with an equivalent rule that already exists elsewhere in the configuration.
Port the stack-safe iterative base64 data-URL parser and strict payload validation so multi-megabyte image uploads cannot overflow V8's call stack.
Port the preview-error helper cleanup so friendly descriptions no longer accept an unused numeric code, with direct regression coverage for mapped, passthrough, and fallback copy.
Port per-runtime ACP assistant item identifiers across Cursor and Grok so provider restarts cannot reuse persisted message IDs, preserving Not Codex client identity in text-generation probes.
Port Windows Electron platform classes and a right-edge root inset so application scrollbars do not block the native resize target, with direct platform-class regression coverage.
Port viewport-aware Enter handling so mobile composer keyboards insert newlines instead of submitting, while preserving plain Enter submission on desktop and Shift+Enter multiline behavior.

Port per-turn Codex runtime model and reasoning-effort disclosure in developer instructions, preserving Not Codex identity and covering explicit, fallback, plan/default, and flattened metadata behavior.
Port idempotent desktop settings navigation so repeated menu shortcuts do not stack duplicate settings history entries, with direct route-boundary regression coverage.

Port AppImage runtime environment scrubbing into the shared terminal-shell helper, preserving user path entries while removing ephemeral mount markers and covering full-mount cleanup and non-AppImage behavior.

Replace the upstream fixed-cwd probe with user-only capability discovery. Not Codex serves multiple projects and worktrees from one provider snapshot, so publishing project/local commands from the immutable server startup cwd would expose the wrong commands to other active threads.

Port centralized invalid-timestamp parsing across absolute, relative, elapsed, and expiry labels, with explicit missing-versus-invalid UI states and regression coverage for empty and malformed values.
Port invalid latest-user-message timestamp fallback so thread ordering recovers from malformed cached metadata by using valid user-message, updated, or created timestamps.
Port provider update checks into the global settings dirty-state summary and restore-defaults payload so a full reset consistently returns every surfaced preference to its default.
Port tolerant provider-session runtime listing so stale rows are skipped with correlated, secret-safe warnings while valid rows and SQL error behavior remain intact.
Port shared MCP OAuth lock directories across Codex auth-overlay homes, replacing only shadow-local ephemeral lock directories while preserving strict conflicts for all other real shared entries.

Adapt the macOS development-launcher identity fix to Not Codex: retain Electron's native executable inside the branded bundle, launch it through a distinct Not Codex script, and keep development-mode runtime semantics.
Port full muted-foreground contrast for question option descriptions so supporting text remains legible across light and dark themes.

Adapt the draft-thread hero landing and composer transition to Not Codex, retaining local settings navigation safeguards and replacing upstream package and animation identifiers with Not Codex equivalents.
Adapt file-explorer mention actions, token-aware mention paste handling, and zoom-aware native context-menu positioning to Not Codex package names and branded file-tree icons.
Port synchronous token-aware mention paste insertion so Lexical handles copied mentions exactly once instead of also running its plain-text fallback, with direct regression coverage.
Adapt restored iOS home and split-sidebar navigation branding to the Not Codex product name and canonical mobile BrandMark instead of upstream T3 identifiers and artwork.
